svg.title: Follow SGD, AdamW and Muon down a computed quadratic matrix loss
svg.desc: Actual matrix-loss optimization, step 80 of 80. The matrix basis mixes the two directions by 45 degrees. Current losses: SGD 0.0304436; AdamW 0.145701; Muon 0.0000156281. Every method recomputes its gradient from its own current weights.
